scope: Future physical-device performance capture preparation, not measured current performance.
historical_parser_scope: Old unoptimized Gear0.2.1 dump-format coverage only; no currentcandidate/emulator/phone performance claim.
profiling_scope: Explicit future invocation clears global SurfaceFlinger counters, samples unique foreground game SurfaceView, dumps/attempts disable in finally; previous counter history/enabled state cannot be restored. No app input/install/save/config/geometry operations.
limitations: Unknown Samsung command/format/hash support until actual device validation.
Foreground sampled, layer checked at boundaries; scenario/actor count need separate actual-game evidence.
Reported average and quantized interval percentiles describe a bounded window; no guaranteed minimumFPS or thermal endurance.
Disconnect/host death can prevent cleanup; failure/partial state must remain explicit.
Physical folding/touch/safe areas/IME/sound/human fun and pacing remain separate gates.
